channel.title: Malaya Publishing Blog
channel.description: Practical, honest guides on local SEO, Google Business Profile, reviews, and AI visibility for Filipino business owners.

item.title: The One-Weekend Local SEO Checklist for a Philippine Business
item.description: A weekend-by-weekend local SEO checklist for Philippine small businesses: verify and complete your Google Business Profile, build a review system, fix citations, and plan ahead.

item.title: How to Handle a Bad Google Review Without Losing Customers
item.description: How to respond to a bad Google review in the Philippines: a calm, non-defensive framework, when a review is actually removable, how to flag fake reviews, and what never to do.

item.title: How to Rank in the Google Local Pack for a Calamba or Laguna Business
item.description: Understand the three local pack ranking factors—relevance, distance, and prominence—and the practical steps a Calamba or Laguna business can take to rank higher on Google Maps.

item.title: How to Get More Google Reviews From Filipino Customers Using Viber, Messenger, and GCash Receipts
item.description: A repeatable system for getting more Google reviews from Filipino customers using a direct review link, QR codes, and well-timed asks through Viber, Messenger, and GCash receipts.

item.title: How to Set Up Your Google Business Profile in the Philippines, Step by Step
item.description: A step-by-step guide to creating, verifying (including GBP video verification), and completing your Google Business Profile in the Philippines so nearby customers can find you on Google.
